description: This file contains a utility class 'RuntimeTypeNameParser' that provides methods for parsing type names formatted by 'RuntimeTypeNameFormatter'. It includes parsing logic for complex type representations including generic types, arrays, nested types, and assembly-qualified names, utilizing internal helper classes and constants for various delimiters and constructs.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameParser
classes.description: A static utility class for parsing type names in a specific format used by Orleans serialization.

classes.name: TypeSpec
classes.description: An abstract representation of a type specification, used internally to model parsed types (implied by usage).

classes.name: TupleTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a tuple type with specific elements and generic arity (implied by usage).

classes.name: NamedTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a named type, including namespace, class name, and generic arity information.

classes.name: ConstructedGenericTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a constructed generic type with type arguments.

classes.name: ArrayTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents an array type with specified dimensions.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a reference (ref or out) type.

classes.name: AssemblyQualifiedTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a type with assembly qualification.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Public method to parse a string type name into a TypeSpec.

methods.name: Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>)
methods.description: Public method to parse a ReadOnlySpan<char> type name into a TypeSpec.
